annotations.title: List Italian regions, provinces and comuni

description: Lists Italian regions, provinces or comuni in alphabetical order, with how many provinces and comuni each region has and how many comuni each province has. Use it to browse the territory and to get the exact names that classifica_territori accepts; do not use it to rank places by tourism figures (use classifica_territori instead) or to look one comune up by name (use cerca_comune instead). Names ignore case, accents and punctuation, and Trentino-Alto Adige is one region with the two provinces of Bolzano and Trento; an unknown or ambiguous name returns an error with the closest names, a comune without a recorded province has null there, and a page past the end is an empty list. Read-only, public, no authentication; 30 requests per minute per client, shared across tools.

livello.description: What to list: "regione" (regions), "provincia" (provinces, optionally of one `regione`) or "comune" (comuni, optionally of one `regione` or `provincia`).

offset.description: Items to skip, default 0: for the next page pass the previous `offset` plus `limite` while `ha_altri` is true.

provincia.description: Optional: only the comuni of this province, by its Italian name in any case ("Firenze", "Bolzano", "Monza e Brianza").

regione.description: Optional: only the provinces or comuni of this region, by its Italian name in any case ("Toscana", "trentino alto adige").

name: elenca_territori

elementi.description: The page of regions, provinces or comuni in alphabetical order; an empty list past the last page.

cod_istat.description: 6-digit ISTAT code of a comune, leading zeros kept: the `cod_istat` input of leggi_dati_comune. Null for regions and provinces.

n_comuni.description: Number of comuni of a region or province; null for comuni.

n_province.description: Number of provinces of a region; null for provinces and comuni.

nome.description: Name as recorded by ISTAT (regions and provinces in capitals): for a region or province, the exact value for `regione` or `provincia` of classifica_territori.

provincia.description: Province of a comune, or the province itself; null for regions and for a comune without a recorded province.

regione.description: Region of a comune or province, or the region itself (Bolzano and Trento are provinces of TRENTINO-ALTO ADIGE); null if not recorded.

fonte.description: Source to cite with the figures: processed by DatiTuristici.it from institutional data (ISTAT).

ha_altri.description: True when more items follow this page: ask again with a larger `offset`.

offset.description: Items skipped before this page, as requested.

totale.description: Number of matching items across all pages.

title: List Italian regions, provinces and comuni
